title: [Mouse Jump] - Keyboard actions (1-9, Home, End, etc) don't appear to work after v0.101

judgment.rationale: The reporter indicates Mouse Jump preview keyboard shortcuts (1-9, Home, End) fail to jump the cursor in v0.101. Additional reproduction details or diagnostic logs are required to confirm if focus or key-mapping is lost.
evidence: Issue report states keyboard shortcuts 1-9, Home, End have no effect in preview window after v0.101 update.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a fresh /bugreport ZIP captured right after attempting Mouse Jump keyboard navigation.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix attempt specifically covers Mouse Jump preview window keyboard navigation failure in v0.101.

proposed_fixes.title: Ensure Mouse Jump preview window retains keyboard focus during preview activation
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Mouse Jump preview window may be losing Win32 keyboard focus or input hook hooks during preview rendering after recent v0.101 updates.
plan: Inspect Mouse Jump preview form focus activation and key handling methods in MouseJump.UI.
Ensure KeyDown / KeyUp event handlers remain attached and preview window receives focus upon trigger.
Add unit/UI tests for keyboard grid navigation in Mouse Jump preview.
verification: Activate Mouse Jump, press numeric keys 1-9 or Home/End, and verify cursor moves to corresponding screen grid cell.

confidence.rationale: The issue report matches a preview window focus loss pattern, but log confirmation or exact focus trace is needed.

issue_context.summary: Mouse Jump keyboard shortcuts (1-9, Home, End) are reported unresponsive in the preview window after v0.101 update.
known_information: PowerToys version v0.101 (reported as v1.101) installed via GitHub release.
Mouse Utilities / Mouse Jump component affected.
inferences: The Mouse Jump preview window may not be correctly capturing WPF/Win32 keyboard focus when opened.
issue_context.analysis: Mouse Jump relies on keyboard focus on the preview overlay window to process numeric/nav keys. If focus shifts or keyboard hooks drop, keypresses are ignored.
initial_investigation: Checked src/modules/MouseUtils/MouseJump/MouseJump.UI/ for keyboard event handler changes in v0.101.

information_gaps.why_needed: To verify module logs and input hook status when Mouse Jump is activated.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce the issue, right-click PowerToys tray icon, select 'Report Bug' (or run BugReportTool.exe), and submit /bugreport comment.

actions.label: Request Mouse Jump diagnostic ZIP and focus trace

comment.body: Could you please reproduce the issue and run /bugreport to capture fresh diagnostics ZIP file right after attempting the Mouse Jump keyboard navigation? This will help us confirm if the preview window is losing focus or key events.
